title: Micron KeyBanc forum business update
canonical_summary: Micron updated supply constraints and raised its US investment commitment at the KeyBanc forum.
known_event_summary: On Aug. 10, Micron said 2027 supply would be tighter than 2026, data-center customers were receiving about half their requested supply, and its US investment commitment had risen from $200B to $250B.

facts.proposition: At the KeyBanc forum, Micron said 2027 supply would be tighter than 2026 and data-center customers were receiving about half of requested supply.
At the KeyBanc forum, Micron increased its US investment commitment from $200 billion to $250 billion.
